name: Dried-anchovy salad
summary: Dried Sê San anchovy fried golden and tossed with green mango and herbs into a sour-sweet salad.
origin: The same Sê San landing article that describes the dried fish.
howToEat: Fry the dried anchovy until golden and mix it with green mango and herbs. The article calls the result a sour-sweet salad.
seoDescription: Golden dried Sê San anchovy tossed with green mango and herbs into a sour-sweet salad.
